_comment: Optional. Groups agent sessions under program headings in the dashboard.
Copy to config/programs.json and edit — that file is gitignored, so your
project names stay on your machine. With no programs.json, sessions are
match: substrings tested against a session's working directory. Keep them
specific; a token like "/api" will claim unrelated folders.

programs.name: Web App
programs.purpose: Ship and maintain the customer-facing site.

programs.name: Infrastructure
programs.purpose: Keep deploys, monitoring, and CI healthy.
